import hashlib
import json

import requests

API_KEY = "your_api_key"
# 平台底层维护了多个上游账号，为了保证亲和性 cache_task_id 参数配置能保证 cache 缓存命中率, 具体参数解释 https://iwiki.woa.com/p/4051772719 务必替换成cache_task_id=<32位MD5>
CACHE_TASK_ID = hashlib.md5(f"chat_demo:{API_KEY}".encode()).hexdigest()
PROVIDER = "stepfun"
URL = "http://api.aihub.woa.com/standard/v1/chat/completions"
HEADERS = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}?cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}",
}
# "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}?provider={PROVIDER}&timeout=3600&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}"

body = {
    "model": "step-5-preview",
    "messages": [
        {"role": "user", "content": "请用JSON格式回答：你好"},
    ],
    "reasoning_effort": "medium",
    "max_tokens": 4096,
    "temperature": 0.5,
    "top_p": 0.9,
    "stream": False,
    "stop": ["END"],
    "frequency_penalty": 0.0,
    "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
    # 与 response_format 不可同传
    # "tools": [{
    #     "type": "function",
    #     "function": {
    #         "name": "get_weather",
    #         "description": "获取城市天气",
    #         "parameters": {
    #             "type": "object",
    #             "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
    #             "required": ["city"],
    #         },
    #     },
    # }],
    # "tool_choice": "auto",
}

# Vision 图片 URL
# 与未要求 JSON 的提示词不可同传
# body.pop("response_format", None)
# body["messages"] = [{
#     "role": "user",
#     "content": [
#         {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": (
#             "https://dashscope.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/"
#             "images/dog_and_girl.jpeg"
#         )}},
#         {"type": "text", "text": "描述这张图片"},
#     ],
# }]

# Vision 图片 Base64
# 与未要求 JSON 的提示词不可同传
# body.pop("response_format", None)
# import base64
# img = requests.get(
#     "https://dashscope.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/"
#     "images/dog_and_girl.jpeg", timeout=60
# ).content
# body["messages"] = [{
#     "role": "user",
#     "content": [
#         {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": (
#             "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
#             + base64.b64encode(img).decode()
#         )}},
#         {"type": "text", "text": "描述这张图片"},
#     ],
# }]

# Vision 视频 URL
# 与未要求 JSON 的提示词不可同传
# body.pop("response_format", None)
# body["messages"] = [{
#     "role": "user",
#     "content": [
#         {"type": "video_url", "video_url": {"url": (
#             "https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4"
#         )}},
#         {"type": "text", "text": "描述这个视频"},
#     ],
# }]

r = requests.post(
    URL, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=3600,
    stream=body["stream"],
)
r.raise_for_status()

if body["stream"]:
    for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if (not line or not line.startswith("data: ")
                or line == "data: [DONE]"):
            continue
        chunk = json.loads(line[6:])
        if not chunk.get("choices"):
            continue
        delta = chunk["choices"][0].get("delta", {})
        print(
            delta.get("reasoning", "")
            + delta.get("content", ""),
            end="",
            flush=True,
        )
    print()
else:
    print(json.dumps(r.json(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

import hashlib
from litellm import completion

API_KEY = "your_api_key"
# 平台底层维护了多个上游账号, 为了保证亲和性 cache_task_id 参数配置能保证 cache 缓存命中率, 具体参数解释 https://iwiki.woa.com/p/4051772719 务必替换成cache_task_id=<32位MD5>
CACHE_TASK_ID = hashlib.md5(f"chat_demo:{API_KEY}".encode()).hexdigest()
LITE_MODEL = "openai/step-5-preview"
LITE_API_BASE = "http://api.aihub.woa.com/v1"

response = completion(
    model=LITE_MODEL,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "你好"}],
    api_base=LITE_API_BASE,
    api_key=f"{API_KEY}?provider=stepfun&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}",
    stream=False,
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)

cache_guidance.affinity_rule: 同一对话上下文复用同一个值，不同对话必须用不同值。该值只影响平台选号：相同值的请求会被路由到同一个上游账号。
cache_guidance.note: 两者需配合使用：cache_task_id 保证请求落到同一账号，prompt 缓存参数才可能在厂商侧命中；只设其一均无缓存收益。affinity_wire_format 为空表示平台尚未对外明确传参方式，请勿自行猜测。
